designationHistory.name: Great White Heron Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: Franklin D. Roosevelt signed Executive Order 7993 setting aside islands in the Florida Keys backcountry as a refuge and breeding ground for great white herons, other migratory birds and other wildlife.
designationHistory.note: Renamed Great White Heron National Wildlife Refuge by Proclamation 2416 (July 25, 1940).

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Lower Florida Keys NWRs Comprehensive Conservation Plan, 2009 (ServCat 168123)
The American Presidency Project (UC Santa Barbara), Executive Order 7993
